entries.brief: Create ONE original square painterly fantasy SPELL ICON for SKAZ D&D 2014. Broad sculpted painted shapes, compact dominant silhouette easily readable at 32 pixels, restrained detail, warm light with dark defining edges on ivory and charcoal backgrounds. CENTRAL 75 percent of square, generous transparent margin on all edges. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No text, runes, lettering, numbers, border, scene, ground, watermark, tiny particles or diffuse bloom. Arcane Sword: one large hovering sword made entirely of luminous translucent violet force, upright diagonal blade with thick geometric edges, simple force crossguard and faceted violet grip. No physical metal or leather; distinguish from mundane flying sword. Two short compact violet arcs show magical suspension. No hand, no person, no other weapon.
